generate_gemini_text: generate text from a Gemini model using AIStudioModel with a text prompt and temperature config
generate_gemini_image_text: generate text from a Gemini model using AIStudioModel with an image and text prompt combined
generate_openai_streaming: generate streaming text from an OpenAI model using OpenAIChatCompletionsModel with stream enabled
generate_anthropic_with_thoughts: generate text from a Claude model using AnthropicModel that includes reasoning thoughts in the response
process_anthropic_stream: process an Anthropic streaming event list into an AnthropicReturn with main response and token counts
